name: User Live Status
description: Lets each user set a personal presence status (online/busy/away/offline) with a visual indicator in the toolbar.
project_description:
User Live Status module allows users to set a personal status with a visual indicator. This helps communicate availability, mood, or activity at a glance across the site.

 Features

 Allows users to set a custom status.

 Displays a visual indicator alongside the status

 Lightweight and easy to configure

 Installation

 Download the module using composer.

 Enable the User Status module through the admin interface or via drush.

 Usage

 Users can set or update their status from the toolbar tab.
